full_details: You stayed in all morning. In one mouth king is service, in another resistance, in a third habit, and in a fourth hope. The margin says not every king a crown, and some are only a cough. There was less new matter than you wanted. The captain's scene can move. The Flint leaf stayed as Sunday left it. You went over the Bridge on foot. From the Bankside walk the flag was up, and the wherries were thick at the stairs. You were not in the Shrew. You stood by a post on the right. Alleyn came through the door in the lion's skin, taller than the door, and the voice filled the house. A labour, then a bigger labour. The yard counted them. You enjoyed it against your will, and you did not say so. At the bridge foot Henslowe was counting, and he knew you. He asked whether the wit pays. You said by the share. He pays by the play, six pound, and he never argues the jig. You did not answer him with the glass. At home you said they have spent heavily, and that the money was not wasted, and that the thing to set against a giant is a looking-glass.
one_sentence: You sorted four uses of the word king, stood in the Rose yard for Hercules, and came home to a looking-glass.
title: Four uses of the word king, and a lion's skin
